question: Which lifecycle should be the supported signal for external workflow completion: per-run `agent_end`, persisted `session_end`, or a new internal HOOK.md event?
rationale: Current main intentionally separates agent-run, persisted-session, and subagent completion, so implementing the requested name without selecting semantics would create overlapping lifecycle contracts.

options.title: Use typed `agent_end`
options.body: Document `agent_end` as the completion signal for workflow plugins and keep `session_end` limited to persisted-session termination.

options.title: Add an internal mirror
options.body: Define one exact existing lifecycle boundary and expose it as a coarse operator-installed internal event with a stable payload.

options.title: Broaden `session_end`
options.body: Redefine typed session completion to include agent, cron, or subagent completion and provide compatibility and duplicate-fire proof.

recommendation.title: Use typed `agent_end`
recommendation.body: Document `agent_end` as the completion signal for workflow plugins and keep `session_end` limited to persisted-session termination.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history on typed session-hook contracts and rollover lifecycle behavior.
